Implement JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7386)

Export applyMergePatch(target, patch) from src/index.ts. It applies a merge
patch to a target document, following MergePatch in RFC 7386, and returns a
new value that shares no mutable structure with either input. Adds tests for
each acceptance criterion of task-004 and documents the function in the README.
